stage.quote: We're thrilled to announce Reflex (formerly Pynecone - more on that in a bit!) and the $5 million we raised in seed funding led by Lux Capital
stage.note: No evidence of a priced round after the August 2023 seed; company (as Pynecone) launched on YC W23 and rebranded to Reflex.

total_funding_usd.basis: company blog post announcing the seed round; no later round found
total_funding_usd.quote: Reflex has raised a $5M seed round led by Lux Capital.

last_round.quote: the $5 million we raised in seed funding led by Lux Capital with participation from Abstract Ventures, Box Group, Y Combinator, Picus Capital, and Outset Capital

note: Founded as Pynecone (open-source pure-Python web framework), launched on YC W23, rebranded to Reflex in 2023. Raised a $5M seed round (Aug 2023) led by Lux Capital with YC and several notable angels participating. YC company page confirms the same reflex.dev domain, W23 batch, and 'Active' status, matching the hint. No subsequent priced round (e.g. Series A) was found in the time available; product has since expanded into 'Reflex Cloud' hosting and an AI app builder.
